recordDescription: One document-level survey with its metadata and every distinct archival object under items. Object ID identifies objects; Sample ID identifies observations within an object. Repeated entries are the same object.

schemaNodes.name: collection_title
schemaNodes.description: Collection title, not an object's title.

schemaNodes.name: items
schemaNodes.description: One archival object identified by its printed Object ID, including every theme and sample observation. A repeated entry or continuation with the same Object ID is the same object, not a new record. Survey metadata is not an object. Return null for fields not recorded.

children.name: record_id
children.description: The unique Object ID, such as OBJ-001234-01.

children.name: title
children.description: The object's title, not the collection title.

children.name: year
children.description: The object's recorded year; null if not recorded.

children.name: themes
children.description: All printed themes; each distinct theme once.

children.name: observations
children.description: Every row of this object's observation table; identify rows by sample_id.

children.name: sample_id
children.description: Sample ID in the observation row.

children.name: count
children.description: Count in the same observation row.
